chunks: Ali (ibn al-Hakam) from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
ai.seo_question: Is reconciliation (sulh) permissible in Islamic law according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes *al-sulh* as a valid legal mechanism for resolving disputes and waiving rights, reflecting the Shia emphasis on amicable settlement (*islah*) over litigation. It underscores the principle that mutual consent can alter legal standings, provided it does not contravene divine law, thereby serving as a cornerstone for civil jurisprudence (*fiqh al-mu'amalat*).
